values.note: $32 a night for the seven inner back-in sites (18-24), $36 for the rest: the lakeside row (1-11) and the pull-throughs (12-17). All 30-amp with water; the same on a Tuesday and a Saturday in November 2026 and June 2027 ($224 / $252 a week). Vehicles need the daily ParkPass, paid once per stay.

fees.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530175 (Campsite 18 '$32.00 Per Night', Campsite 03 '$36.00 Per Night' on 2026-11-10, 2026-11-14, 2027-06-19; all sites 2027-06-15); https://gastateparks.org/KolomokiMounds ('Overnight guests pay daily ParkPass fee only once per vehicle during their stay'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 530175 site details (all 24 public sites 'Electricity Hookup: 30', 'Water Hookup: Y'; 'Sewer Hookup: Y' only on site 25, the host's), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 25 electric sites on the booking site, one (25) the host's, leaving 24 public, all 41-79 ft so all take a 23-ft rig; 6 pull-throughs (12-17). The park page's '25 Tent, Trailer & RV Campsites' counts the host site. Plus a hammock site, two pioneer campgrounds and a group camp.

note: GA DNR state historic park (Woodland-period Native American mounds) on Lake Kolomoki. Sites 1-11 line the lake behind a mown strip of shoreline; the inner sites are under the trees. Boat ramp. The museum is closed while it adapts to NAGPRA rules; ranger-led tours continue (park page, 2026-10-29). --Claude
summary: Booking engine still ReserveAmerica.
